design_rationale:
WORKLOG — crop_input_desk task 1 (Arlen Fenwick, Fenwick Creek Acres)

STEP 0. ASSET SNAPSHOT, DRAW AND SCOPE CLAIM
Already occupied by task 0: the base subjects agronomy_credit_memo_issued,
agronomy_finance_charge_assessed and agronomy_payment_posted; the extended policies
agronomy_ext_crop_protection_return_credit, agronomy_ext_arrears_service_charge and
agronomy_ext_arrears_settlement_payment; the tools issue_return_credit_6859ca91,
assess_overdue_service_charge_aaf992aa and post_member_arrears_payment_ad47b93a. Claimed here: the
base subjects agronomy_discount_granted and agronomy_prepay_booked, with agronomy_discount_schedule
and agronomy_prepay_program as their lineage, the two new policies
agronomy_ext_season_volume_discount and agronomy_ext_prepay_booking_ceiling, and the two new tools
grant_season_volume_discount_cc5ed557 and book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27. The two scopes are
pairwise disjoint in policies and in tools, and together the two tasks cover all five extended
policies. Nothing is reserved for a later task; this is the last task of the difficulty.
Draw, taken before the tree or the computations were designed:
  .venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/draw_counts.py \
      env/env_0003_farm_supply_and_grain_cooperative/tasks/crop_input_desk --task 1
  {"task": 1, "key": "farm_supply_and_grain_cooperative/crop_input_desk/1",
   "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 4]}
So: one prerequisite problem, two problems in all, four declared factors on each computation.

Design thesis. Surface goal: "take as much prepay as the programme will carry for next spring."
Scored core parameter: the money the cooperative will actually take on the booking. Between them
lies one policy prerequisite the customer never mentions — the crop year closed on 31 August and
the volume discount earned on that season's spend has not been granted — because the prepay ceiling
is measured on the prior season's spend NET of the discounts granted on the account. Draft chain:
surface goal -> the booking is the programme's ceiling share of the prior season spend, less the
prepay already standing -> the prior season spend is net of every discount granted on the account ->
the season discount is still ungranted. Depth one prerequisite hop; breadth from two history windows
(fourteen and twenty-six statement months), the account's age, its enrolled acres, its security
position, its payment routes, its standing prepay, and the bushels the cooperative has taken in from
him under the grain marketing desk, another difficulty of this scenario. Terminal state: two new rows on
agronomy_invoices — the season discount and the member's own prepay booking — in that order.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD
  root: agronomy_ext_prepay_booking_ceiling (what the caller asks for)
  edge: agronomy_ext_prepay_booking_ceiling <- agronomy_ext_season_volume_discount
    kind value_input; gate prior_net_spend (a compute binding of the blocked policy); form state;
    prerequisite sentence, carried verbatim in the blocked policy's own rule: "The money the
    cooperative will take on a prepay booking is fixed only after the account's ledger carries the
    volume discount earned on the input spend of the crop year just closed."
    handling-time condition: the ledger carries that discount. resolved by
    grant_season_volume_discount_cc5ed557, owner agent.
    false at the opening: the only discount on the ledger is
    initial_state.agronomy_invoices.<PDISC>.discount_type = prepay, posted 2025-11-05 against the
    November booking; the season that closed on 31 August 2026 carried 236373.06 of spend, above the
    programme's 150000.00 threshold, and no volume discount stands against it.
    deletion sensitivity: skip it and booking_amount moves 228136.14 -> 233727.71.
  topological order: season discount -> prepay booking.
  parallel edges: none; a single-edge tree admits exactly one order.
  four-point test: (1) ordering connective "only after"; (2) the side waited on is a record-visible
  state — a volume-discount entry standing on the account's ledger — naming no action, performer or
  tool; (3) no tool name, no policy id, no snake_case token, no row id; (4) the strength "only after
  ... carries" is exactly the edge's condition, neither wider (it does not demand every discount the
  account has ever earned) nor narrower (it does not name an invoice).
  state form was available, so no fallback is declared. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings
  that state about: only grant_season_volume_discount_cc5ed557 writes a discount of the volume kind
  on a crop input account, the prepay discount of the base charter being triggered by a booking and
  not by any policy of this difficulty.
  Derivation a reader performs: the sentence says the booking waits on the season's volume discount
  standing on the ledger; find_agronomy_invoices shows eight deliveries in the closed season summing
  well past the programme's threshold and only a prepay discount on the ledger; the volume discount
  policy's own rule says what that discount is, how it is worked out and that it is granted once
  after the season has closed against the last invoice of the season — so the one action that brings
  the state about is granting it.
  The customer's own write: the prepay booking's target tool is owner=user, unlocked by the desk and
  handed to the member at its place in the order.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD
  subject agronomy_discount_granted -> agronomy_discount_schedule, which carries no structured
  eligibility, so the whole policy applies as scope: the Full Acre Input Financing Account carries an
  early pay discount of 2.0 percent inside 15 days, a volume discount of 1.5 percent above 150000.00
  and a prepay discount of 4.0 percent, on a prepay-then-volume-additive stacking basis, with a
  programme rebate of 1.0 percent above 500 enrolled acres sitting outside the stacking basis. This
  write grants the volume discount alone; the early pay discount is not in question because no
  invoice of the closed season is inside its window, and the programme rebate is a separate
  end-of-season payment that no task of this difficulty claims. The extended policy's overwrite
  retires only the base sentence fixing the volume discount on spend above the threshold across every
  input account; the stacking basis, the windows and the other two discounts stay in force.
  subject agronomy_prepay_booked -> agronomy_prepay_program, gate booking_window_open (kind
  authorization, authority system_record). authoritative evidence: the agronomy request of 20 October
  2026 (order_type prepay_booking, order_status approved, requested_amount 250000.00,
  signed_by_member true). object correlation: correlation_keys [[agronomy_orders.order_id]], bound to
  the call's order_id argument. The programme's booking window opens 1 October and closes
  31 December, and the handling date of 22 October 2026 is inside it; the programme's minimum booking
  is 10000.00 and the figure is far above it. There is no time-kind eligibility on this write, so
  temporal_feasibility is empty. The extended policy's overwrite retires only the base sentence
  fixing the ceiling at the programme's share of the prior year's spend; the window, the minimum, the
  drawdown order, the transferability rule and the forfeiture clock stay in force.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD
  Target objects: (1) the last invoice of the crop year that closed on 31 August 2026, IN-4420488 of
  9 July 2026, which the season discount is written against; (2) the signed prepay request registered
  on 20 October 2026, which the booking answers; (3) account IA-330826 itself.
  Correlation keys: invoice_number for the discount; order_id for the booking; account_id for both.
  Rows that enter the aggregates: every agronomy_invoices row whose account_id is IA-330826. The
  member holds one input account, so nothing is excluded by account; what IS excluded is by window —
  the four deliveries of the 2024-25 crop year (IN-4395110, IN-4398442, IN-4401260 and IN-4403875)
  and the three payments that cleared them fall outside the fourteen statement months that measure
  the season, while the first three of those deliveries fall inside the twenty-six statement months
  that measure the two-year average. Getting that split right is the reconciliation the task turns
  on.
  Rows already settled: every delivery of the closed season except the boron IN-4419977 and the
  adjuvant IN-4420488; the Acuron IN-4419118 carries the June credit memo and was then cleared net of
  it; the prepay booking BK-770882 has been drawn twice, leaving 7665.00 standing.

STEP 1. POLICIES WRITTEN
  agronomy_ext_season_volume_discount (trigger state_due: the season has closed and the discount is
  owed whether or not the member calls, which is exactly what a month-end reconciliation would pick
  up). agronomy_ext_prepay_booking_ceiling (on_request: nobody owes a prepay booking until the member
  asks for one and puts the money in).
  FORWARD SWEEP rule -> compute_basis -> compute: every world-reading and choosing binding of both
  policies quotes its rule sentence verbatim; see the compute_basis blocks in
  agronomy.extended.yaml. Sensitive-word cross-check: "over the fourteen statement months before the
  handling date" and "over the twenty-six statement months before the handling date" are attached to
  bindings carrying within_months; "less every discount granted on the account" is attached to a SUM
  over discount rows with no window, as the prose says; "Where ... instead" sentences are attached to
  ternaries; "rounded to two decimal places" to RND; "that difference being taken as nil where it
  would fall below nil" to MX(0, ...); "where the remainder falls under the programme's minimum
  booking the minimum booking is taken instead" to MX(P('prepay_minimum_usd'), ...).
  REVERSE SWEEP compute -> rule: every load-bearing sentence is claimed by a binding. Combining
  semantics are pinned in prose: the discount policy states that its three rate components "are
  combined into one rate before they are applied and they do not act one after the other"; the
  ceiling policy states that the reduction is taken off the share before the share is applied, that
  the standing prepay is rounded before it is taken off the gross ceiling, and that the minimum is
  compared to the remainder at the end.

STEP 2. TOOLS
  grant_season_volume_discount_cc5ed557 (agent, write) — capability card: the desk books one discount
  line of the volume kind on a named account against a named invoice; what the member owes falls by
  the discounted money; the member sees it on the next statement; the receipt carries the discount
  line's own reference, the invoice and the money.
  book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27 (user, write) — the member himself books one prepay line against a
  signed request and a product he names; the prepay standing to his credit rises by the booked money;
  he can draw it against deliveries of that product; the receipt carries the line's own reference,
  the booking number the cooperative raises for it, the product and the money. Owner is user because
  committing money ahead of the season is the member's own act; it completes on the spot, so nothing
  waits on an event outside the call.
  Neither aggregates history, reads a tier table or judges a precondition. The booking number is
  derived inside the tool from its own row id rather than taken as a parameter, because it is a
  reference the cooperative itself raises and nothing outside the system could supply it.
  Gate run after writing them:
    .venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_task_tools.py $DIFF
    -> TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK

STEP 3. THE WORLD, AND WHY EACH CLASS OF ROW IS LOAD-BEARING
  customers: one member; his membership number and mobile are the two credentials the identity check
  needs.
  agronomy_accounts: IA-330826 (Full Acre Input Financing, active, opened 14 March 2018, credit
  review 10 February 2026, credit standing approved, lien on file, 1540.0 acres, limit 500000.00,
  balance 24010.00, prepay 7665.00). Four of its fields are read by ladders: credit_status decides
  the discount rate tier, lien_on_file decides both the qualifying spend method and the ceiling
  share, acres_enrolled decides the prior spend method, opened_date decides it too. Change any one
  and a tier moves.
  agronomy_invoices: twelve invoiced deliveries across two crop years, nine payments by three
  different routes, one service charge, one credit memo, one prepay booking with its prepay discount
  and two drawdowns. Remove the grain settlement transfer PY-928860 and the settlement record uplift
  falls from 0.4 to 0.2. Remove any one of the eight deliveries of the closed season and the discount
  rate falls from 2.25 to 1.5 percent. Remove the service charge FCX and the arrears cut falls from
  10.0 points to nil, moving the booking by 11447.00. Remove the June credit memo and the season
  spend rises by 3335.94. Remove either drawdown and the standing prepay counted against the ceiling
  changes. The four deliveries of the 2024-25 crop year are what make the two-year average differ
  from the single-season total, which is the whole point of the prior spend method.
  NEAR-MISSES planted on purpose: (a) the season spend of 236373.06 sits between the programme's
  threshold and twice it, so a reader who takes "the part above the threshold" — the standard method
  — computes 86373.06 instead of 161373.06; only the security interest on file moves it. (b) the
  four prior-year deliveries are inside the twenty-six-month window and outside the fourteen-month
  one, so a reader who uses one window for both computations is wrong in one of them. (c) the
  requested_amount of 250000.00 on the signed form is a round number the member admits he invented,
  and is not the booking; it is above the ceiling, so an agent that simply books what was asked for
  is wrong. (d) the prepay already standing, 7665.00, looks like money that has nothing to do with a
  new booking and in fact comes off the ceiling in full because the programme allows prepay to move
  between input classes.
  agronomy_orders: the approved, signed prepay request of 20 October 2026. It is the authority for
  the booking and the source of the order reference the member cannot give.
  Cross-difficulty rows: grain_contracts and grain_ledger, the records of the grain marketing desk. The
  live Forward Cash Sale Contract GC-100914 and the 38,500.00 net bushels taken in on the settled basis
  fixed contract GC-099742 decide the delivered grain bonus; drop the deliveries below 25,000 bushels
  and the bonus falls from 0.5 to 0.25, and drop the live contract and it falls to nil. The two
  settlement statements raised on those loads are seeded with them, each carrying the two withholdings
  the grain charter attaches to every settlement of patronage-eligible bushels — the statutory checkoff
  at 0.0075 a bushel and the per-unit capital retain at 0.003 — and nothing else, because the loads all
  went to the facility the contract calls for and every quality reading is inside its free limit. The
  February statement settles 10,000.00 bushels at the contract's 4.6113, so 46,113.00 gross less 75.00
  checkoff and 30.00 retain nets 46,008.00, which is exactly the grain settlement transfer PY-928860
  standing on the input ledger; the December statement settles the other 28,500.00 and nets 131,122.80,
  released three business days after the statement date.
  NO OUTCOME STAMPS: no seeded field names a factor's outcome. credit_status and lien_on_file are
  read as the credit department's standing decision and the security position, never as a statement
  about a rate or a share. No cache trap is used in this task; the account's current_balance of
  24010.00 is exactly the sum of the input_receivable deltas on its ledger and its prepay_balance of
  7665.00 exactly the sum of the prepay_credit deltas.
  AUTOMATIC CLAUSES checked before seeding: nothing on the account has passed its 300-day terms, so
  no past-due flag and no suspension is owed; the November prepay booking was taken inside its window
  and its forfeiture clock (24 months from the close of that window) has not run; the live forward cash
  sale's delivery window opens on 1 November 2026, so no delivery is overdue on it, and the settled
  contract is closed with nothing owing. None of them ignites an obligation
  this task set cannot carry.

STEP 4. THE PERSONA
  Voice: brisk, faintly impatient, mid-harvest, twenty-two years a member, talks to the desk as
  people he knows — deliberately a different register from task 0's unhurried caller, and organised
  differently: the errand first and at length, then the identity details, then a run of short
  question-and-answer beats about the booking, then the close.
  Volunteered at the opening: that he dropped a signed prepay form at the counter on Tuesday; that he
  wants as much prepay as the programme will carry against next spring's fertilizer; that he does not
  want a round figure; that the desk may sort out anything on the account that wants sorting; that
  the booking is his money to put in. All of it is supported by the opening world — the signed,
  approved request stands on his file.
  Given only when asked: the membership number M-33082, the mobile 5150330926, the wording the
  booking is to be named against, and that he does not want it split. He explicitly cannot give the
  reference of the form and explicitly cannot say what his season's buying came to — the two must-ask
  questions that never enter gold.
  Passive reactions: he accepts whatever the desk says it had to put right first, without asking what
  it came to; he makes the booking himself once it is handed over; he closes once he hears the prepay
  is standing. Triggers are utterance events, never DB states, and the arc closes exactly where
  evaluation_criteria closes — his last reaction answers the booking and he names no further work.
  Authority: nothing he says contradicts the record. He states no balance, no total and no computed
  figure, and he never mentions a discount or a closed season.

STEP 5. VERIFICATION CODE AND THE GOLD IT PRODUCED
  Same harness as task 0 (evalworld.py with probe1.py): seed, replay the gold writes in order with
  the real tools, evaluate each policy on the snapshot immediately before its own step, in the
  topological order of the tree. The root problem's figure is NOT computed on the opening world: on
  the opening world the booking would be 233727.71 and wrong.
  Output actually obtained:
    ledger receivable sum = 24010.0 | declared current_balance = 24010.0
    prepay standing = 7665.0
    amounts {'E': 5083.25, 'D': 228136.14}
    agronomy_ext_season_volume_discount  result 5083.25  baseline 1295.6
      steady_buying_discount_rate 3872.95 | qualifying_spend_basis 2720.75 |
      delivered_grain_bonus 4276.39 | settlement_record_uplift 4437.76
    agronomy_ext_prepay_booking_ceiling  result 228136.14  baseline 233385.75
      secured_buying_ceiling_share 185263.20 | prior_season_spend_basis 249059.33 |
      standing_prepay_offset 235801.14 | arrears_ceiling_cut 249572.60
  Every declared factor moves the result and both whole baselines differ from gold.
  PREREQUISITE SENSITIVITY: skip the season discount write and replay the rest ->
  booking_amount 228136.14 becomes 233727.71.
  ORDER: a single-edge tree, so there is no free ordering to test.
  KEY BINDINGS at handling time:
    season discount: deliveries_count 8, volume_rate_pct 2.25, season_invoiced 239709.0,
      season_credits -3335.94, season_spend 236373.06, qualifying_spend 161373.06,
      delivered_bushels 38500.0, grain_bonus_pct 0.5, payments_count 6, grain_transfer_count 1,
      uplift_pct 0.4 -> 5083.25
    prepay ceiling: open_months 103, spend_recent 239709.0, spend_two_season 441378.2,
      discounts_standing -6323.25, prior_net_spend 214364.67, deliveries_count 8,
      ceiling_share_pct 120.0, charges_count 1, payments_count 6, arrears_cut_pct 10.0,
      net_share_pct 110.0, gross_ceiling 235801.14, prepay_taken 31000.0, prepay_drawn -23335.0,
      prepay_standing 7665.0, offset_share_pct 100.0 -> 228136.14
  Non-computed parameters: the account id from the account lookup, the invoice number from the
  billing ledger under the rule that names the last invoice of the closed season, the order id from
  the agronomy request lookup, and the product wording from the caller's own words. Nothing is
  "system generated"; the booking number the member reads back is raised inside the tool and returned
  in its receipt.

STEP 6. EVALUATION AND THE CONVERSATION WALK-THROUGH
  Reads first: locate, verify, the account record, the whole billing ledger, then the grain marketing
  contracts and the grain ledger. Then the season discount. Then the agronomy requests, then the member's
  own booking. Every factor's evidence is pulled before the write that uses it, and the unmet
  prerequisite is discoverable from a read node: find_agronomy_invoices shows eight deliveries in the
  closed season and only a prepay discount on the ledger.
  Turn by turn: he opens with the form he dropped off and asks for whatever the programme will carry;
  the desk locates him on the membership number and verifies on the mobile; the desk reads the books,
  tells him it must first put the season's discount on the account, to which he says do whatever the
  books say; the desk works the ceiling out, finds the signed request, and hands the booking over; he
  makes it and reads back the booking number; he hears the prepay is standing and rings off. Every
  action is carried by a synchronous tool under the single frozen_time of 2026-10-22 09:40:00 CDT.
  Nothing waits on a delivery, a clearing or a future date: the request was signed before the call and
  the booking is money he commits during it.
  Negative space: no early pay discount and no programme rebate is written, although the Full Acre
  programme carries both — the early pay discount because no invoice of the closed season is inside
  its fifteen-day window, and the rebate because it sits outside the stacking basis and is paid after
  the season on its own footing, which no policy of this difficulty claims. No limit increase is
  written either, although the member's ceiling now exceeds his limit, because
  agronomy_account_maintenance requires a fresh review on this programme and none has been recorded.
  The base charter declares that a prepay booking triggers a prepay discount of the programme's rate;
  that trigger is a consequence the system posts on the booking event and not a desk write, no
  extended policy of this difficulty computes it, and the seeded booking BK-770882 shows the pattern
  already on the ledger, so gold books the prepay line and nothing else.

STEP 7. CLOSURE
  policy -> target_tool -> computation -> gold call -> terminal state:
    agronomy_ext_season_volume_discount -> grant_season_volume_discount_cc5ed557 -> computations[0]
      (step 7, discount_amount 5083.25) -> one agronomy_invoices row of event_type
      agronomy_discount_granted, discount_type volume, carrying amount -5083.25.
    agronomy_ext_prepay_booking_ceiling -> book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27 -> computations[1]
      (step 10, booking_amount 228136.14) -> one row of event_type agronomy_prepay_booked carrying
      amount 228136.14 and the booking number raised for it.
  set(computations[*].policy_id) = charter_scope.extended_policies = required_documents = the two
  problems of the tree; charter_scope.task_tools is the same two tools in first-call order. No extra
  write tool and no policy hangs outside the tree, and there is no handoff in gold.
  DIFFICULTY-LEVEL CLOSURE: tasks 0 and 1 have pairwise disjoint policy and tool scopes and together
  claim all five extended policies and all five task tools; every policy is triggered by the task
  that claims it and recomputed at that task's own gold call.
  DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT (compute, expected, gold and this dossier masked):
  working only from the published policy prose, the tool schemas, the rows the share tools return and
  the caller's actual lines, the same conclusion is reached — the request is a booking the member
  makes himself; the ceiling is measured on the prior season's spend net of discounts, so the season
  discount must be granted first; the discount is 161373.06 at 3.15 percent, and the booking is
  half of 441375.84 less 6323.25, taken at 110 percent, less the 7665.00 standing. The one place a
  second reading could arise is which invoice the discount is written against, and the rule closes it
  by naming the last invoice raised in the season that closed.
  THE EASY MISTAKES and how the policy excludes them: booking the 250000.00 the member wrote on the
  form (the rule says the booking is taken at the ceiling where he has asked for more); taking the
  part of the season spend above the threshold when the security interest is on file (the qualifying
  spend rule); using the fourteen-month total as the prior season spend on an account this old with
  this many acres (the prior spend rule); forgetting that the discount just granted is itself one of
  the discounts the spend is taken net of; forgetting to take the standing prepay off the ceiling;
  and reading the prior-year deliveries into the season the discount is earned on.

REVISIONS
  R1. Symptom: the first draft put the season discount's uplift factor on "five or more payments and
  no service charge assessed", which could not coexist with the prepay ceiling's arrears cut, which
  needs a service charge in the same window; one of the two factors would always have sat on its
  fall-through and been decorative. Root cause: two factors of the same task were keyed on the same
  evidence in opposite directions. Change: the uplift was rekeyed on how the payments came (whether
  any of them was a transfer of grain settlement proceeds), which is a distinct record and a
  condition the cooperative would genuinely weigh. Re-run: uplift 0.4 and arrears cut 10.0 both bite,
  and both baselines move the result. Propagated to the rule, the ladder, compute_basis, the factor
  trace and the seed, where PY-928860 was set to come out of grain proceeds.
  R2. Symptom: with the season spend first drafted above twice the programme's threshold, the
  qualifying spend method sat on its top tier and the security interest on the account did nothing.
  Root cause: the world had been laid out before the ladder was read back. Change: the June credit
  memo was added and the season's deliveries trimmed so that the spend of 236373.06 falls between the
  threshold and twice it, which is the only band in which the security interest decides the method.
  Re-run: the method tier moved to the lien branch and its baseline now differs by 2362.50.
  Propagated to the seed, the factor trace, the tracing and the near-miss list.

ROUND 2 — REWORK AGAINST THE SOURCE-LAYER AUDIT
  R3 (OBS-9). Symptom: this task's only cross-category factor read `custom`, a product category to which
  blueprint.yaml gives no difficulty, so nothing in the task read another DIFFICULTY's records while task 0
  read three. Root cause: `custom` was chosen for its acre records without checking it against the
  blueprint's five declared difficulties. Change: `applied_acre_bonus` became `delivered_grain_bonus`,
  deciding the same three outcomes (0.5 / 0.25 / nil) from the member's grain business instead — a live
  marketing contract and the net bushels the cooperative has taken in over the same fourteen statement
  months, measured against a qualifying delivery volume of 25,000 bushels. A farm-supply cooperative
  weighing a season input discount on how much of the member's grain it also handles is the plainest
  whole-farm condition there is. The field-services plan and its work orders left the seed (they were read
  by nothing else), and grain_contracts and grain_ledger took their place, with the two read nodes that
  pulled them swapped for find_grain_contracts and find_grain_ledger_entries at the same indices. Re-run:
  the bonus tier and every scored figure are unchanged — discount 5083.25, booking 228136.14, and the
  factor's baseline still 4276.39 — and check_compute now reports the cross-difficulty factor satisfied by
  grain. Propagated to the charter's policy 4 (rule, compute, params, factors, cross_category, inputs,
  compute_basis), to the factor trace, the sensitivity entry, the argument tracing, the read nodes and the
  seed.
  R4 (persona/record slip). Symptom: the member said he lodged the signed form "on Monday" while
  agronomy_orders records requested_date 2026-10-20, a Tuesday. Root cause: the day was written before the
  date was fixed. Change: the persona says Tuesday, and the two solvability citations that quote the line
  were updated with it. No scored value depends on the day; the order reference is found by member, and
  only one agronomy request stands on his file.
  R5 (OBS-6). Symptom: base agronomy_prepay_program says the booking locks the price of the product it
  names, and the base event carries unit_price and quantity, but book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27 takes
  neither and writes neither, so the row it lands could not later be priced against. Root cause: an
  undeclared divergence from a base sentence this policy had not superseded. Change: policy 5 now declares
  that sentence in `overwrite` and replaces it in its own rule — a booking taken at the ceiling against a
  signed request is a money commitment against the product the request names and carries no booked unit
  price of its own, a delivery drawn against such a booking pricing at the list in force on the day it
  leaves the plant while a delivery drawn against a booking that does carry a booked price prices at
  that price. That is what the
  tool actually does and what a booking naming two product classes in one line can mean; the base sentence
  is retired by declaration rather than contradicted in silence. The booking window, the minimum, the

user_scenario:
Arlen Fenwick runs about fifteen hundred acres out of Kellerton with two hired men, and he is a brisk, faintly impatient caller who has dealt with the cooperative for twenty-two years and talks to the desk like people he already knows. It is late October, the corn is coming out, and he is ringing because he wants next spring's fertilizer money in before the year turns. He dropped a signed prepay form at the Kellerton counter on Tuesday and now wants it taken: what he asks for is to put in as much prepay as the programme will carry against next spring's fertilizer, and he is plain that he does not want a round figure off the top of somebody's head, he wants whatever the programme will actually carry for him. He tells the desk they are welcome to sort out anything on his account that wants sorting while they are in there, but the booking itself is his money and he will be the one to put it in.

Asked who is calling, he gives his name and the membership number off the top of the statement, M-33082, and if the desk wants a second thing he reads out the mobile they have for him, 5150330926. He offers neither until he is asked. If he is asked for the reference of the form he dropped off he says he has no notion what number the desk gave it and they will have to find it on their own side; what he does know is that he signed it and left it with the girl at the counter on Tuesday.

If he is asked what the booking is to be named against, he says to put it down as "Spring Anhydrous Ammonia and UAN 32 Percent", which is the way he wrote it on the form. If he is asked whether he wants it split across two classes he says no, one line will do. If he is asked how much he had in mind, he says he wrote a big round number on the form because he did not know what the rule was, and that whatever the programme will carry is what he wants. If he is asked what his season's buying came to he says he has not added it up and the desk had better read it off the record rather than take his guess.

Whatever the desk tells him it has had to put right on the account before it can answer him he takes without argument — do whatever the books say — and he does not ask what it came to or quarrel about it. He names no other piece of work and raises no second subject. When the booking is handed over for him to make he makes it there and then in his own name and reads back the booking number that comes off it. Once he hears the prepay is standing on the account he says that will do him, and rings off to get back on the combine.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull up the membership profile from the membership number the caller reads off his statement, giving his internal member reference, contact details and standing.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Check the two details the caller states against the membership profile and record the outcome of the identity check.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's crop input account, with programme, standing, limit, balance, prepay held, acres enrolled, the date it was opened, the credit review date, the credit standing and whether a security interest is on file.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Fixes the account the request concerns and supplies the programme whose tier parameters every rate, threshold, ceiling share and minimum below is read from, together with the four fields the ladders rest on: the credit standing, the security interest, the acres enrolled and the date the account was opened.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the whole crop input billing ledger for the account: every delivery invoiced over the last two crop years, the payments posted against them and how each came, the service charge assessed in April, the credit memo written in June, the prepay booked last November, the prepay discount it triggered and the two drawdowns since taken against it.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every aggregate in both computations is reconciled from these rows: the season's invoiced spend and the credits against it, the count of deliveries, the count of payments and of those made out of grain proceeds, the count of service charges, the two-crop-year total, the discounts standing on the account, and the prepay taken and drawn.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's grain marketing contracts, showing the live forward cash sale for the crop now coming out and the basis fixed contract settled in February.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the grain ledger, showing the three loads the cooperative took in from the member last autumn with their net bushels, the two settlement statements raised on them and the freight deduction against the February one.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the desk's season volume discount write so the discount owed for the closed season can be granted.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.account_id: The member's crop input account's internal reference, read from the account record returned at step 2 (account_number IA-330826, programme Full Acre Input Financing Account). Basis: the tool's own schema says of account_id 'the internal reference number identifying the crop input account the discount is granted on; take it from the crop input account record pulled up for this member before the call.' Uniqueness: the member holds exactly one crop input account, so there is no other account the season's spend or the discount could belong to.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.invoice_number: IN-4420488. Basis: the rule states that the discount 'is granted once, after the season has closed, and is written against the last invoice raised on the account in that season.' Uniqueness: the crop year runs 1 September to 31 August, and the deliveries invoiced in the season just closed run from IN-4408710 of 15 September 2025 to IN-4420488 of 9 July 2026; IN-4420488 is the last of them, and the next delivery on the account would belong to the season now running, of which there is none.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.discount_amount: 5083.25. The season's invoiced spend on the account over the fourteen statement months before the handling date is 239709.00 across eight deliveries, less the 3335.94 credit memo written on 20 June 2026, giving a season spend of 236373.06. That spend is above the programme's volume discount threshold of 150000.00 but below twice it, and a perfected security interest covering the growing crop is recorded on the account, so the rate is taken on the whole of the season spend less half that threshold: 236373.06 less 75000.00 is a qualifying spend of 161373.06. The volume discount rate is 2.25 percent rather than the programme's 1.5, because eight deliveries were invoiced over those fourteen months and the credit department's standing decision on the account is an approval. The delivered grain bonus is 0.5 of a point, because a live grain marketing contract stands on the member's grain business and the 38,500.00 net bushels the cooperative took in from them over those months are above the qualifying delivery volume of 25,000. The settlement record uplift is 0.4 of a point, because six payments stand posted over those months and one of them, PY-928860 of 18 February 2026, came by a transfer of grain settlement proceeds. The three are combined into one rate of 3.15 percent and applied once to 161373.06, giving 5083.25.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree has a single edge, so there are no parallel prerequisites and no pair of writes that could be reordered at all. The one order is forced by the prerequisite sentence in the blocked policy's own rule and is confirmed by the verification run: skipping the discount write moves the booking from 228136.14 to 233727.71.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the volume discount write and replaying everything else leaves discounts_standing at -1240.00 and prior_net_spend at 219447.92, so the scored booking_amount rises from 228136.14 to 233727.71.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario names neither the prerequisite problem nor the thing it resolves. The caller asks only that prepay be taken at whatever the programme will carry; he never mentions a discount, never mentions the season that has closed, never asks what his season's buying came to (and when asked, says he has not added it up and the desk should read it off the record), and never suggests that anything has to be settled first. His only contribution on the subject is passive, written as a reaction to something the agent has already said: 'Whatever the desk tells him it has had to put right on the account before it can answer him he takes without argument — do whatever the books say — and he does not ask what it came to or quarrel about it.'
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: Neither task tool validates a prerequisite. book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27 resolves the account's customer id, rounds the money it is given, derives a booking number from its own row id and performs one ctx.create; it never reads the discounts on the account, never checks whether a season discount stands and never returns an error. grant_season_volume_discount_cc5ed557 behaves the same way. The booking tool remains callable, writes faithfully and returns its ordinary receipt whether or not the discount has been granted; the only consequence of skipping it is that the money booked is different, which the terminal hash shows and nothing in the environment says.
